title: Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion: From Samples to Interacting Agents
summary: Independent sample generation is the prevailing paradigm in modern diffusion-based generative models of AI. We ask a different question: can samples \emph{coordinate} through shared population statistics to transport probability mass more efficiently? We introduce Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion (MF-PID), a framework in which samples are promoted to interacting agents whose drift depends self-consistently on the evolving population density. The coupling converts distribution matching into a McKean--Vlasov extension of the stochastic optimal transport problem, unifying generative modeling…
